name: gap-aware-line
title: Gap-Aware Line
description: Pure-SVG line chart that breaks the line at null readings, shades and labels each gap, keeps a lone reading between gaps as a dot, draws estimated points hollow with dashed segments, and backs every reading with a data table.

meta.summary: A line chart that shows missing readings as gaps instead of drawing them as zero or smoothing over them.
catches: Missing readings drawn as a drop to zero
Gaps smoothed over into a false trend
A single reading between two gaps disappearing
Estimated or modelled values passed off as measured
limits: Only null means missing; a real 0 is drawn as 0, so your data must distinguish them
Does not detect gaps in timestamps; pass a null for each missing slot
Not a general charting library: one series, no zoom
a11y: Chart is role=img with an aria-label that includes a text summary
Points are reachable by keyboard (Arrow keys, Home, End) and the active point is read out in a polite live region
A toggle (aria-pressed) swaps the chart for a captioned data table; the table stays available to screen readers when hidden
Estimated points differ by shape (hollow, dashed), not only colour
